title: SQL injection in product search (UNION-based)
impact: Full read/write access to the primary application database, including the users table (password hashes, PII).
reproduction: GET /v2/search?q=widget' UNION SELECT NULL,version(),NULL-- -
Observe the DB version string rendered in the results list
Enumerate information_schema.tables via the same injection point
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for the search handler; apply least-privilege to the DB role.

title: Authentication bypass → administrator account takeover
impact: An unauthenticated attacker can assume any account, including administrators, and reach the full admin console.
reproduction: Submit login with a crafted JWT whose 'role' claim is elevated and 'alg' set to none
Server accepts the unsigned token
Navigate to /admin — full access granted
remediation: Reject tokens with alg=none; pin the expected algorithm server-side; verify signatures against the correct key.

title: SSRF to cloud metadata → temporary credential theft
impact: The 'fetch' feature reaches the cloud metadata endpoint, exposing short-lived IAM credentials for the app role.
reproduction: POST /v2/fetch {"url":"http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/"}
Role name returned
Request the role path to retrieve (redacted) temporary credentials
remediation: Allowlist egress destinations; block link-local/metadata ranges; require IMDSv2; isolate the fetch service.

title: Stored XSS in support-ticket body (renders in agent console)
impact: A customer-submitted ticket executes script in the support agent's authenticated session (session theft, actions as agent).
reproduction: Create a ticket whose body is an img tag with an onerror handler exfiltrating document.cookie
A support agent opens the ticket in the console
The payload fires in the agent's origin
remediation: Context-aware output encoding when rendering ticket content; a strict CSP; sanitize HTML on input.

title: Insecure deserialization in session cookie
impact: The session cookie is a serialized object; a benign URLDNS gadget proves attacker-controlled data is deserialized (RCE-adjacent).
reproduction: Decode the session cookie — it is a serialized object
Replace with a URLDNS gadget pointing at the OOB host
Observe the DNS callback on cookie processing
remediation: Do not deserialize untrusted data; use signed, opaque session identifiers; restrict gadget classes.

title: Reflected XSS in marketing campaign parameter
impact: A crafted link executes attacker script in a victim's browser in the example.com origin.
reproduction: Request /promo with a ref parameter breaking out of the attribute into a script context
The ref value is reflected unencoded in the page
Script executes on load
remediation: HTML-encode reflected parameters; add a CSP; validate the 'ref' allowlist.

title: CSRF on email-change endpoint (no anti-CSRF token)
impact: A cross-origin page can change a logged-in user's account email, enabling a password-reset takeover.
reproduction: Host an auto-submitting form POSTing to /account/email
Logged-in victim visits the page
Email changes with no token challenge; SameSite does not block it
remediation: Require a per-request anti-CSRF token; set SameSite=Lax/Strict; re-authenticate for sensitive changes.

title: Clickjacking — missing frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options
impact: Sensitive pages are framable, enabling UI-redress against state-changing actions.
reproduction: Frame /account in an attacker page
No frame protections present
Overlay a decoy to drive a sensitive click
remediation: Set Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'; add X-Frame-Options: DENY on sensitive routes.

title: Server technology & version disclosure
impact: Response headers disclose the exact server and framework versions, easing targeted exploit selection.
reproduction: HEAD /
Inspect Server and X-Powered-By headers
remediation: Suppress or genericize version banners (Server, X-Powered-By).

title: Blind SQL injection (time-based) in report filter
impact: A reliable time-based boolean differential confirms injection. Data extraction could not be shown because the staging DB is unseeded.
reproduction: POST a filter with a conditional time delay → +5s response
Control with zero delay → baseline latency
Differential reproducible across 10 trials
remediation: Parameterize the report filter; least-privilege DB role.

review.notes: Injection confirmed by timing; extraction blocked by unseeded staging DB — reported as demonstration-limited.

title: Unauthenticated → cloud account compromise
impact: Chaining SSRF→metadata (RS-2026-003) with the leaked role enables pivot into the cloud account.
reproduction: See chain-001 in attack_chains.json

title: Self-XSS in developer console paste
impact: Requires the victim to paste attacker code into their own console — no cross-user vector.
reproduction: Paste payload into DevTools console

review.notes: No delivery path to another user; self-XSS is not a reportable vulnerability.
